response.sql:
WITH album_stats AS (
    SELECT
        AlbumId,
        SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END), 0) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM Track
    GROUP BY AlbumId
), mean_rate AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate
    FROM album_stats
)
SELECT
    AVG(a.rate) AS average_rate,
    AVG(a.track_count) AS average_track_count,
    AVG(a.rate - m.rate) AS average_excess_rate
FROM album_stats AS a
CROSS JOIN mean_rate AS m
WHERE a.rate > m.rate;

assumptions.assumption: Albums are the groups represented by Track.AlbumId, including all tracks with a NULL AlbumId in one group. Rates use only tracks with a non-NULL Bytes value, and albums with no usable size or a zero summed duration have an undefined rate and are excluded from the mean and above-mean result.
